g.text: A Why you can't think your way out

g.text: B How it scales

g.text: D The way through (practice first)

g.title: R1
g.text: R1 Limbo
knowing and not letting yourself know;
the turning away steers behavior

g.title: R2
g.text: R2 Contempt = malice + pretense it isn't
limbo aimed at someone; judged from the state
he judges you for; produces what it accuses

g.title: A1
g.text: A1 Hijack of reasoning
grand plans built by the arguing side; rules as escape hatch;
metrics; the memo in the file; reason in service; clues not rules

g.title: A4
g.text: A4 Limbo is the water
dual motives; the thrill; enemies vs allies; subtle forms;
THE AGENDA LOOK (self-serving push w/o heat: everyone reads it,
they know and don't; still limbo, still teaches the lesson);
'my clarity proves I'm clean'; UNCONSCIOUS (mine) vs CONSCIOUS (yours):
same state, two names, both collapse the paradox

g.title: C1
g.text: C1 What they are
evil = result of turning away; gradient (check, not assert);
THE FAR END: the knowing GROWS while access shrinks -> knows most
and least at once; what horrifies you is a suppressed PRESENCE,
not an absence; it shows itself so you'll press harder;
'they need the most love' = flat reading, not sentiment;
IN VIEW DEFINED (3 checks, independent of harm): objection lands /
hurt registers AS BAD / what's in them can change you;
SADISM = deep limbo: sameness suppressed, not absent; signature of
suppression is the falsifier; (sees a subject, fails all 3;
Ch2 trip fits: innocence devoured, life not);
psychopaths 'I don't know' (which check is off?);
ALL EVIL IS INNOCENT + regress trap

g.title: R3
g.text: R3 The hiding is the revealing
hidden from him, shown to you, one act;
benefits from being seen as him

g.title: T0
g.text: T0 THE OPENING (author's draft)
agent = parasite of sorts, evictable; true nature (or lack) later;
stranger: knew and didn't -- collapsing the paradox = confusion;
handshake offered and ACCEPTED; freedom would have denied it
(2nd stranger) -> parasite reaches down to PERCEPTION;
evil = far extreme; must actually SEE the parasite, not pretend;
parasites cooperate: pair/room/building/species = the Devil;
hatred of corruption = real you; of people = parasite; don't go easy;
+ IN THEM: soldier, two days, 'that wasn't me' = accurate reporting;
+ IN YOU: the face; relief or robbed?; the OTHER handshake
(2nd stranger's anger had nothing for the parasite; went past it)

g.title: A2
g.text: A2 Hijack of perception
the verdict becomes what you see; world indistinguishable
from one where it's true; YOU CANNOT DECIDE TO LOOK
(2nd stranger makes looking survivable; why not just fix Hitler);
two righteousnesses / trance; TWO IDENTICAL ACTS, OPPOSITE EFFECTS;
'notice how sure you are'

g.title: A3
g.text: A3 The tug
contempt = a tug to be recruited into the thing you hate;
SELF-RIGHTEOUS CONTEMPT named (the 'self' is the tell): malevolence (check 1), spreads the thing (check 2);
accuracy is the hook; soldiers/corpse: conscience knows w/o proof; faith-robbing -> proof culture

g.title: B0
g.text: B0 Hot and cold
contempt = incomplete turning away (protest audible);
cold = complete (nobody home); further along, not milder;
most of the world's harm runs on cold

g.title: C2
g.text: C2 Contempt from below
rage/force are right; only the verdict on trial; who benefits;
the SAME thing runs the one above; the tug at its strongest;
King; remorse vs shame; self-contempt

g.title: D3
g.text: D3 What remains
hinge gave existence; this gives SIZE (not derivable):
not a better me, not a version of me; second stranger revisited;
fierce not nice; 'compassion is weak' as a lie;
handshake of the Light; the ones who wouldn't hand me over;
your own clean moments

g.title: R4
g.text: R4 The handshake
our darknesses collaborate;
each supplies the other's evidence

g.title: R5
g.text: R5 Both halves
fully responsible AND not what you are

g.title: B2
g.text: B2 Plausible deniability at scale
every parasite needs the split + unauditable channels;
1000 hosts -> policy/procedure/omission; institution =
the need for not-looking made PERMANENT; CEO; shadowy agents

g.title: D1
g.text: D1 What it's made of
layers 1-3; FEAR underneath; layer 4: no creature;
addresses the full-strength reader FIRST + LOW-DOSE version for
everyone (the bully who changed tactics with you);
cold/drowning/hull: absences kill; it 'wants' because it runs on a
whole person with the caring off -> looks MORE than human;
it wears a FACE -- and you can recognize the same one twice;
both hands; PAYOFF: an essence could only be ended by ending them

g.title: E7
g.text: E7 APPENDIX 1 Part Three: IMPLICIT COMMON KNOWLEDGE
street = recursive mutual recognition under deniability (not CK);
under care-as-nature + self-knowing + turning-away-as-the-one-mistake,
the sameness is CK at the level of awareness (a fixed point) and
unavowable at the level of persons; contempt = the anti-ritual;
2nd stranger enacts the sameness so it can't be disavowed;
needs indistinguishable nature, not numerical oneness

g.title: D5
g.text: D5 Part F: the four sides + what this book is for
ONE IDEA, FOUR SIDES stated whole (one move / all wrongdoing /
contempt purest / only turning-toward helps); a shared sayable
name removes deniability (NOT common knowledge); the limit;
it will be weaponized (gaslighting precedent); CLOSE: under the bet,
what the bet is for: what stopped you on the street was what was
doing the looking; 'I can't take you further than suspecting'; epigraph

g.title: R6
g.text: R6 Ch5 THE WHOLE OF IT
every thesis once, tiered (checked / inferred / believed);
follows this graph's topological order; the short version

g.title: B1
g.text: B1 Shadow spaces & the hum
Dave's-working-from-home offer; alliances needing no structure;
LOCKER ROOM: 10 parasites behaving as one, felt from the doorway,
stops when the wife walks in; the room recruits you FOR or AGAINST;
strategy meetings; the hum; small shadows need large ones

g.title: B4
g.text: B4 The conspiracy
pair/room/building/ALL -> one thing, one purpose;
AGENCY SIGNATURES (checkable): it DEFENDS itself (naming it in the
room makes you the suspect); it RECRUITS (each joiner lowers the
cost); it ADAPTS (attention makes it intensify, not stop -- Ch1);
Devil/Mara; TEST: two at war, both grow -> always on both sides;
real conspiracies exist, this is the ROOT; trance; extermination;
contempt IS evil; does it matter what we call it?

g.title: D0
g.text: D0 THE ONLY LEVER
'what's left?' -> CARE, derived from the gaze experiment and the
size of the hiding; remembered not built (subtraction, not building);
NOT-SEEING ISN'T CHOSEN, NOT-LOOKING-AGAIN IS TRAINABLE
(what improves is how fast you catch it); oldest religious claim;
without-sin = mechanism; the book as weapon spreads it; checks;
two versions of judgment + the ESCAPE HATCH; the SKILL of seeing
turning-away requires seeing your own; author not finished;
fierce = passes all 3 in-view checks and fights anyway (C1);
compassion vs wisdom; good-person trap; tools

g.title: B3
g.text: B3 Marks on the culture (non-metaphysical)
'humans are greedy'; revenge films; compassion called naive;
living world as inventory (checkable); matter deferred to D4

g.title: D4
g.text: D4 What you are
THE RECOGNITION (perception, not inference); traditions personify
(weak evidence); step past the opening: ONE absence in many places
(shadows / one sun); nondual argument: nothing distinguishes two
awarenesses; Baumeister + objection (shared world, no shared seeing);
conscience = the world knowing itself; THE TREE AND THE ARCH (§16):
the faculty fires on non-minds; contempt for the world; fear of having left
God/Love/Source (Wapnick corroborates); sealed room; matter;
impact of integrity; good = what helps remember

g.title: D6
g.text: D6 APPENDIX 3, the traditions (was §17)
marigpa = non-recognition; afflictions as display; adventitious;
non-fabrication + familiarization; POINTING-OUT = 2nd stranger;
SAMANTABHADRA: blank first, no motive, self/other AFTER;
RECONCILED with the fear of §15: blank first, fear = what the
blank feels like once there's someone to feel it;
WHAT'S MINE: coordination across minds; THE ROAD IN (the hiding
proves the care; from your worst moment, not your best; Mencius, Augustine
nearest; two roads, one place = abductive support both ways);
caution: not permission
